abstract: |
  **Latar Belakang:** Karsinoma sel hati (KSH) sebagian besar terdiagnosis pada stadium lanjut sehingga terapi sistemik lini pertama seperti lenvatinib menjadi pilihan utama. Respon klinis terhadap lenvatinib sangat bervariasi dan dipengaruhi cadangan fungsional hati. Skor Albumin-Bilirubin (ALBI) menawarkan penilaian fungsi hati yang objektif dibandingkan skor Child-Turcotte-Pugh (CTP).

  **Metode:** Studi kohort retrospektif pada pasien KSH tidak dapat direseksi (BCLC B non-kandidat kuratif/lokoregional dan BCLC C) yang menerima terapi lenvatinib di RSUP Prof. dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah periode 1 Januari 2023 hingga 31 Desember 2025. Penilaian luaran menggunakan pendekatan *intention-to-treat* (ITT) berdasarkan kriteria mRECIST pada minggu ke-12 hingga ke-16 (Penyakit Terkontrol [CR/PR/SD] vs Penyakit Progresif [PD/meninggal sebelum evaluasi CT]). Analisis mencakup statistik deskriptif, bivariat (*Chi-square*/*Fisher exact* dan *Relative Risk*), penentuan titik potong variabel numerik melalui kurva ROC/AUC, serta regresi logistik biner multivariat.

```{r}
#| label: setup-and-data
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PAKET & PARAMETER KENDALI ANALISIS
# ==============================================================================
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(car)
library(DiagrammeR)

TARGET_N          <- 68       # Besar sampel minimal sesuai proposal
MODE_PRIOR_TX     <- "auto"   # "auto" (eksklusi jika n tanpa prior tx >= 68), "exclude", atau "include"
P_SCREEN_MULTI    <- 0.25     # Ambang p bivariat masuk kandidat multivariat
MAX_MISSING_MULTI <- 0.20     # Proporsi missing maksimal agar variabel aman masuk regresi multivariat
SHEET_TARGET      <- "MAIN_60"
DIR_FIG_EXPORT    <- "Figures_Thesis_Editable"
dir.create(DIR_FIG_EXPORT, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fungsi aman menangani list-column, koma desimal, dan simbol >/< dari Google Sheets
to_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    vapply(x, function(el) if (length(el) == 0 || is.null(el)) NA_character_ else as.character(el[1]), character(1))
  } else {
    as.character(x)
  }
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  s <- trimws(to_chr(x))
  s[s %in% c("", "-", "NA", "N/A", "Tidak ada", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  s <- gsub("^[<>]=?\\s*", "", s)
  s <- ifelse(grepl(",", s) & grepl("\\.", s), gsub(",", "", s), gsub(",", ".", s))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s))
}

to_date_safe <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))
  s <- trimws(to_chr(x))
  s[s %in% c("", "-", "NA", "Tidak ada")] <- NA_character_
  d <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(s))
  miss <- is.na(d) & !is.na(s)
  if (any(miss)) {
    d[miss] <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(s[miss], format = "%d/%m/%Y"))
  }
  d
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "-", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3)))
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "-", format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 2. IMPOR DATA DARI GOOGLE SHEETS (KOLOM A:AF TAB MAIN_60)
# ==============================================================================
# Jalankan googlesheets4::gs4_auth() sekali di Console RStudio sebelum Render
# (atau ganti baris di bawah menjadi gs4_deauth() jika akses sheet disetel publik)
gs4_auth(email = TRUE)

url_sheet <- "[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A6WNMCTLlWBLoow7D_ak3Yjy1DNDGgSv26aveFiQTJY/edit?gid=0#gid=0](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A6WNMCTLlWBLoow7D_ak3Yjy1DNDGgSv26aveFiQTJY/edit?gid=0#gid=0)"

data_raw <- read_sheet(
  ss        = url_sheet,
  sheet     = SHEET_TARGET,
  range     = "A:AF",
  col_types = "c"
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RM) & trimws(RM) != "")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. PEMBERSIHAN & KALKULASI VARIABEL SESUAI DEFINISI OPERASIONAL PROPOSAL
# ==============================================================================
data_clean <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # Numerik dasar (AFP sudah dalam satuan ng/mL sesuai RSUP Ngoerah)
    Usia_Num          = to_num(USIA_DIAGNOSIS),
    ECOG_Num          = to_num(ECOG_SKOR),
    CTP_Skor_Num      = to_num(CTP_SKOR_ANGKA),
    mCCI_Num          = to_num(MCCI_SKOR),
    AFP_ng_Num        = to_num(AFP_NG_ML),
    PIVKA_Num         = to_num(PIVKA_II_MAU_ML),
    Albumin_gdL       = to_num(ALBUMIN_G_DL),
    Bilirubin_mgdL    = to_num(BILIRUBIN_TOTAL_MG_DL),
    Limfosit_Num      = to_num(LIMFOSIT_TOTAL_MM3),
    BB_kg             = to_num(BERAT_BADAN_KG),
    Dosis_Awal_Aktual = to_num(DOSIS_AWAL_LENVATINIB_MG),
    Total_Dosis_12m   = to_num(TOTAL_DOSIS_TERIMA_12MG),
    Jumlah_Nodul      = to_num(JUMLAH_NODUL),
    Ukuran_Maks_cm    = to_num(UKURAN_NODUL_TERBESAR_CM),

    # Nilai pra-kalkulasi dari sheet (untuk audit selisih)
    ALBI_Sheet        = to_num(SKOR_ALBI),
    PNI_Sheet         = to_num(SKOR_PNI),
    RDI_Sheet         = to_num(RDI_PERSEN),

    # Tanggal
    Tgl_Mulai         = to_date_safe(TGL_MULAI_TERAPI),
    Tgl_Eval          = to_date_safe(TGL_EVALUASI_12MG),
    Tgl_FU_Meninggal  = to_date_safe(TGL_MENINGGAL_ATAU_TERAKHIR_FOLLOWUP),
    Hari_ke_Evaluasi  = as.numeric(Tgl_Eval - Tgl_Mulai),
    Hari_FU           = as.numeric(Tgl_FU_Meninggal - Tgl_Mulai),

    # Standarisasi teks kategorik
    Jenis_Kelamin = case_when(
      grepl("^L", trimws(JENIS_KELAMIN), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Laki-laki",
      grepl("^P", trimws(JENIS_KELAMIN), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Perempuan",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    BCLC_Kat = case_when(
      grepl("^B", toupper(trimws(BCLC_STADIUM))) ~ "BCLC B",
      grepl("^C", toupper(trimws(BCLC_STADIUM))) ~ "BCLC C",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Etiologi_Kat = case_when(
      grepl("non", trimws(ETIOLOGI_KELOMPOK), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Non-viral",
      grepl("viral", trimws(ETIOLOGI_KELOMPOK), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Viral",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    CTP_Kat = case_when(
      toupper(trimws(CTP_KELAS)) == "A" ~ "CTP A",
      toupper(trimws(CTP_KELAS)) %in% c("B", "C", "B-C") ~ "CTP B-C",
      !is.na(CTP_Skor_Num) & CTP_Skor_Num <= 6 ~ "CTP A",
      !is.na(CTP_Skor_Num) & CTP_Skor_Num >= 7 ~ "CTP B-C",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ECOG_Kat = case_when(
      ECOG_Num %in% c(0, 1) ~ "ECOG 0-1",
      ECOG_Num >= 2         ~ "ECOG >= 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Identifikasi riwayat terapi sebelumnya & kriteria eksklusi
    Riwayat_Tx_Raw = trimws(coalesce(RIWAYAT_TERAPI_SEBELUMNYA, "")),
    Is_Transplant  = grepl("transplant", Riwayat_Tx_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Is_Prior_Tx    = (!Is_Transplant) & grepl("tace|reseksi|ablasi|rfa|sbrt|tare|operasi|peit", Riwayat_Tx_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE),

    # 1. Skor ALBI (Bilirubin mg/dL x 17.1 -> umol/L; Albumin g/dL x 10 -> g/L)
    Skor_ALBI_Calc = ifelse(
      !is.na(Bilirubin_mgdL) & Bilirubin_mgdL > 0 & !is.na(Albumin_gdL),
      (0.66 * log10(Bilirubin_mgdL * 17.1)) - (0.085 * (Albumin_gdL * 10)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    Skor_ALBI  = coalesce(Skor_ALBI_Calc, ALBI_Sheet),
    ALBI_Grade = case_when(
      Skor_ALBI <= -2.60                     ~ "Derajat 1",
      Skor_ALBI > -2.60 & Skor_ALBI <= -1.39 ~ "Derajat 2",
      Skor_ALBI > -1.39                      ~ "Derajat 3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ALBI_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(Skor_ALBI <= -2.60, "ALBI Derajat 1", "ALBI Derajat 2-3"),
      levels = c("ALBI Derajat 2-3", "ALBI Derajat 1")
    ),

    # 2. Luaran Respon Radiologis mRECIST 12-16 Minggu (Pendekatan ITT)
    mRECIST_Raw = trimws(coalesce(MRECIST_HASIL, "")),
    Respon_Detail = case_when(
      grepl("^CR$|complete", mRECIST_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE)              ~ "CR",
      grepl("^PR$|partial", mRECIST_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE)               ~ "PR",
      grepl("^SD$|stable", mRECIST_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE)                ~ "SD",
      grepl("^PD$|progressive", mRECIST_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE)           ~ "PD (CT Evaluasi)",
      grepl("meninggal|death|wafat|dead", mRECIST_Raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Meninggal / Tanpa CT (ITT -> PD)",
      mRECIST_Raw %in% c("", "-", "NA", "N/A", "Tidak ada", "Belum evaluasi") ~ "Meninggal / Tanpa CT (ITT -> PD)",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Lainnya (", mRECIST_Raw, ") -> PD")
    ),
    Status_Evaluasi = ifelse(
      Respon_Detail %in% c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD (CT Evaluasi)"),
      "CT Evaluasi 12-16 Minggu",
      "Tanpa CT / Meninggal (ITT -> PD)"
    ),
    Respon_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(Respon_Detail %in% c("CR", "PR", "SD"), "Penyakit Terkontrol", "Penyakit Progresif"),
      levels = c("Penyakit Progresif", "Penyakit Terkontrol")
    ),
    Respon_Bin = ifelse(Respon_Kat == "Penyakit Terkontrol", 1L, 0L),

    # 3. Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI)
    Skor_PNI_Calc = ifelse(
      !is.na(Albumin_gdL) & !is.na(Limfosit_Num),
      (10 * Albumin_gdL) + (0.005 * Limfosit_Num),
      NA_real_
    ),
    Skor_PNI = coalesce(Skor_PNI_Calc, PNI_Sheet),
    PNI_Kat  = factor(
      ifelse(Skor_PNI >= 49.75, "PNI Baik (>=49.75)", "PNI Buruk (<49.75)"),
      levels = c("PNI Buruk (<49.75)", "PNI Baik (>=49.75)")
    ),

    # 4. Kriteria Up-to-Seven
    Skor_UpToSeven = ifelse(
      !is.na(Jumlah_Nodul) & !is.na(Ukuran_Maks_cm),
      Jumlah_Nodul + Ukuran_Maks_cm,
      NA_real_
    ),
    UpToSeven_Kat = case_when(
      !is.na(Skor_UpToSeven) & Skor_UpToSeven <= 7 ~ "Sesuai (<=7)",
      !is.na(Skor_UpToSeven) & Skor_UpToSeven > 7  ~ "Tidak Sesuai (>7)",
      grepl("within|sesuai|in", UP_TO_SEVEN_STATUS, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Sesuai (<=7)",
      grepl("beyond|out|tidak", UP_TO_SEVEN_STATUS, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tidak Sesuai (>7)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    UpToSeven_Kat = factor(UpToSeven_Kat, levels = c("Tidak Sesuai (>7)", "Sesuai (<=7)")),

    # 5. RDI 12 Minggu (84 hari) berbasis Berat Badan (>=60 kg = 12 mg; <60 kg = 8 mg)
    Dosis_Standar_BB = ifelse(BB_kg >= 60, 12, 8),
    RDI_Calc = ifelse(
      !is.na(Total_Dosis_12m) & !is.na(Dosis_Standar_BB),
      (Total_Dosis_12m / (Dosis_Standar_BB * 84)) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    RDI_12m = coalesce(RDI_Calc, RDI_Sheet),
    RDI_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(RDI_12m > 66.7, "RDI >66.7%", "RDI <=66.7%"),
      levels = c("RDI <=66.7%", "RDI >66.7%")
    ),

    # 6. AFP, PIVKA-II, mCCI, Prior Tx
    AFP_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(AFP_ng_Num < 200, "AFP <200 ng/mL", "AFP >=200 ng/mL"),
      levels = c("AFP >=200 ng/mL", "AFP <200 ng/mL")
    ),
    PIVKA_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(PIVKA_Num < 40, "PIVKA-II <40 mAU/mL", "PIVKA-II >=40 mAU/mL"),
      levels = c("PIVKA-II >=40 mAU/mL", "PIVKA-II <40 mAU/mL")
    ),
    mCCI_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(mCCI_Num <= 1, "mCCI Rendah (0-1)", "mCCI Tinggi (>=2)"),
      levels = c("mCCI Tinggi (>=2)", "mCCI Rendah (0-1)")
    ),
    Prior_Tx_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(Is_Prior_Tx, "Ada Riwayat TACE/Reseksi/Ablasi", "Naif Terapi"),
      levels = c("Ada Riwayat TACE/Reseksi/Ablasi", "Naif Terapi")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 4. PENERAPAN KRITERIA INKLUSI & EKSKLUSI (SAKELAR PRIOR TX OTOMATIS)
# ==============================================================================
n_terjangkau <- nrow(data_clean)
n_ex_usia <- sum(with(data_clean, is.na(Usia_Num) | Usia_Num < 18), na.rm = TRUE)
n_ex_trans   <- sum(data_clean$Is_Transplant, na.rm = TRUE)
n_ex_albi_na <- sum(is.na(data_clean$Skor_ALBI))

data_base <- data_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Usia_Num) & Usia_Num >= 18,
    !Is_Transplant,
    !is.na(Skor_ALBI)
  )

n_prior_tx_avail <- sum(data_base$Is_Prior_Tx, na.rm = TRUE)
n_tanpa_prior_tx <- sum(!data_base$Is_Prior_Tx, na.rm = TRUE)

exclude_prior_final <- case_when(
  MODE_PRIOR_TX == "exclude" ~ TRUE,
  MODE_PRIOR_TX == "include" ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ (n_tanpa_prior_tx >= TARGET_N)
)

if (exclude_prior_final) {
  df <- data_base %>% filter(!Is_Prior_Tx)
  n_ex_prior_used <- n_prior_tx_avail
  ket_prior_tx <- paste0(
    "Jumlah sampel tanpa riwayat terapi sebelumnya (n = ", n_tanpa_prior_tx,
    ") memenuhi target minimal (n >= ", TARGET_N, "), sehingga ", n_prior_tx_avail,
    " pasien dengan riwayat TACE/reseksi/ablasi dieksklusi."
  )
} else {
  df <- data_base
  n_ex_prior_used <- 0
  ket_prior_tx <- paste0(
    "Jumlah sampel tanpa riwayat terapi sebelumnya (n = ", n_tanpa_prior_tx,
    ") kurang dari target minimal (n = ", TARGET_N, "), sehingga ", n_prior_tx_avail,
    " pasien dengan riwayat TACE/reseksi/ablasi tetap diinklusi dan diuji sebagai kovariat."
  )
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Jenis_Kelamin = factor(Jenis_Kelamin, levels = c("Perempuan", "Laki-laki")),
    BCLC_Kat      = factor(BCLC_Kat, levels = c("BCLC C", "BCLC B")),
    Etiologi_Kat  = factor(Etiologi_Kat, levels = c("Non-viral", "Viral")),
    CTP_Kat       = factor(CTP_Kat, levels = c("CTP B-C", "CTP A")),
    ECOG_Kat      = factor(ECOG_Kat, levels = c("ECOG >= 2", "ECOG 0-1"))
  )

# Ringkasan angka kunci untuk inline text & diagram alur
n_final       <- nrow(df)
n_albi1       <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 1", na.rm = TRUE)
n_albi23      <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 2-3", na.rm = TRUE)
n_itt_pd      <- sum(df$Status_Evaluasi != "CT Evaluasi 12-16 Minggu", na.rm = TRUE)
n_dcr_total   <- sum(df$Respon_Bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
pct_dcr_tot   <- fmt_num(100 * n_dcr_total / n_final, 1)

n_albi1_ctrl  <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 1" & df$Respon_Bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_albi1_pd    <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 1" & df$Respon_Bin == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_albi23_ctrl <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 2-3" & df$Respon_Bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_albi23_pd   <- sum(df$ALBI_Kat == "ALBI Derajat 2-3" & df$Respon_Bin == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: calc-roc-usia
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ==============================================================================
# 5. KURVA ROC / AUC UNTUK VARIABEL NUMERIK (USIA & ALBI KONTINU)
# ==============================================================================
roc_usia <- roc(
  response  = df$Respon_Bin,
  predictor = df$Usia_Num,
  quiet     = TRUE,
  ci        = TRUE
)

best_usia <- coords(
  roc_usia,
  x           = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret         = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
  transpose   = FALSE
)[1, ]

cutoff_usia <- round(best_usia$threshold, 1)
auc_usia    <- fmt_num(as.numeric(auc(roc_usia)), 3)
auc_usia_lo <- fmt_num(as.numeric(ci.auc(roc_usia))[1], 3)
auc_usia_hi <- fmt_num(as.numeric(ci.auc(roc_usia))[3], 3)
sens_usia   <- fmt_num(best_usia$sensitivity * 100, 1)
spec_usia   <- fmt_num(best_usia$specificity * 100, 1)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Usia_Kat = factor(
      ifelse(Usia_Num < cutoff_usia, paste0("< ", cutoff_usia, " tahun"), paste0(">= ", cutoff_usia, " tahun")),
      levels = c(paste0(">= ", cutoff_usia, " tahun"), paste0("< ", cutoff_usia, " tahun"))
    )
  )

roc_albi <- roc(
  response  = df$Respon_Bin,
  predictor = df$Skor_ALBI,
  direction = ">",
  quiet     = TRUE,
  ci        = TRUE
)
best_albi   <- coords(roc_albi, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                      ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"), transpose = FALSE)[1, ]
auc_albi    <- fmt_num(as.numeric(auc(roc_albi)), 3)
auc_albi_lo <- fmt_num(as.numeric(ci.auc(roc_albi))[1], 3)
auc_albi_hi <- fmt_num(as.numeric(ci.auc(roc_albi))[3], 3)
cut_albi_op <- fmt_num(best_albi$threshold, 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: calc-bivariat-multivariat
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ==============================================================================
# 6. ANALISIS BIVARIAT (CHI-SQUARE / FISHER EXACT + RELATIVE RISK 2x2)
# ==============================================================================
calc_bivar <- function(data, var_name, label_var) {
  d_sub <- data %>%
    select(x = all_of(var_name), y = Respon_Bin) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y))

  n_valid <- nrow(d_sub)
  prop_na <- (nrow(data) - n_valid) / nrow(data)
  lvls    <- levels(d_sub$x)

  if (n_valid < 5 || length(lvls) != 2) return(NULL)

  a <- sum(d_sub$x == lvls[2] & d_sub$y == 1)
  b <- sum(d_sub$x == lvls[2] & d_sub$y == 0)
  c <- sum(d_sub$x == lvls[1] & d_sub$y == 1)
  d <- sum(d_sub$x == lvls[1] & d_sub$y == 0)

  if ((a + b) == 0 || (c + d) == 0) return(NULL)

  mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  chi_obj <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE))

  if (any(chi_obj$expected < 5)) {
    p_val  <- fisher.test(mat)$p.value
    metode <- "Fisher Exact"
  } else {
    p_val  <- chi_obj$p.value
    metode <- "Chi-square"
  }

  if (any(c(a, b, c, d) == 0)) {
    a_c <- a + 0.5; b_c <- b + 0.5; c_c <- c + 0.5; d_c <- d + 0.5
  } else {
    a_c <- a; b_c <- b; c_c <- c; d_c <- d
  }

  p1 <- a_c / (a_c + b_c)
  p0 <- c_c / (c_c + d_c)
  rr <- p1 / p0
  se_log_rr <- sqrt((1 / a_c) - (1 / (a_c + b_c)) + (1 / c_c) - (1 / (c_c + d_c)))
  rr_lo <- exp(log(rr) - 1.96 * se_log_rr)
  rr_hi <- exp(log(rr) + 1.96 * se_log_rr)

  tibble(
    Var_Col        = var_name,
    Variabel       = label_var,
    n_valid        = n_valid,
    Prop_Missing   = prop_na,
    Kategori_Uji   = paste0(lvls[2], " vs ", lvls[1]),
    Terkontrol_Exp = paste0(a, "/", a + b, " (", fmt_num(100 * a / (a + b), 1), "%)"),
    Terkontrol_Ref = paste0(c, "/", c + d, " (", fmt_num(100 * c / (c + d), 1), "%)"),
    RR             = rr,
    RR_Low         = rr_lo,
    RR_High        = rr_hi,
    RR_CI          = paste0(fmt_num(rr, 2), " (", fmt_num(rr_lo, 2), "–", fmt_num(rr_hi, 2), ")"),
    p_num          = p_val,
    p_value        = fmt_p(p_val),
    Uji            = metode
  )
}

daftar_prediktor <- list(
  c("ALBI_Kat",      "Skor ALBI Pra-Terapi"),
  c("Usia_Kat",      paste0("Usia (cut-off ROC ", cutoff_usia, " th)")),
  c("Jenis_Kelamin", "Jenis Kelamin"),
  c("BCLC_Kat",      "Stadium BCLC"),
  c("Etiologi_Kat",  "Etiologi KSH"),
  c("CTP_Kat",       "Skor Child-Pugh (CTP)"),
  c("ECOG_Kat",      "Status Performa ECOG"),
  c("AFP_Kat",       "Kadar AFP Pra-Terapi"),
  c("PIVKA_Kat",     "Kadar PIVKA-II Pra-Terapi"),
  c("PNI_Kat",       "Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI)"),
  c("UpToSeven_Kat", "Beban Tumor (Up-to-Seven)"),
  c("mCCI_Kat",      "Komorbiditas (mCCI)"),
  c("RDI_Kat",       "Relative Dose Intensity (RDI 12 Minggu)")
)

if (!exclude_prior_final && n_prior_tx_avail > 0) {
  daftar_prediktor <- append(daftar_prediktor, list(c("Prior_Tx_Kat", "Riwayat Terapi Sebelumnya")))
}

hasil_bivariat <- bind_rows(lapply(daftar_prediktor, function(v) calc_bivar(df, v[1], v[2])))

row_albi_biv <- hasil_bivariat %>% filter(Var_Col == "ALBI_Kat")
rr_albi      <- fmt_num(row_albi_biv$RR, 2)
rr_albi_lo   <- fmt_num(row_albi_biv$RR_Low, 2)
rr_albi_hi   <- fmt_num(row_albi_biv$RR_High, 2)
p_albi_biv   <- row_albi_biv$p_value
dcr_albi1    <- row_albi_biv$Terkontrol_Exp
dcr_albi23   <- row_albi_biv$Terkontrol_Ref

# ==============================================================================
# 7. ANALISIS MULTIVARIAT (REGRESI LOGISTIK BINER + CEK VIF & MISSINGNESS)
# ==============================================================================
vars_dilewati_missing <- hasil_bivariat %>%
  filter(Var_Col != "ALBI_Kat" & p_num < P_SCREEN_MULTI & Prop_Missing > MAX_MISSING_MULTI) %>%
  pull(Variabel)

kandidat_vars <- hasil_bivariat %>%
  filter(Var_Col == "ALBI_Kat" | (p_num < P_SCREEN_MULTI & Prop_Missing <= MAX_MISSING_MULTI)) %>%
  pull(Var_Col) %>%
  unique()

df_multi      <- df %>% select(Respon_Bin, all_of(kandidat_vars)) %>% na.omit()
n_multi_final <- nrow(df_multi)

formula_multi <- as.formula(paste("Respon_Bin ~", paste(kandidat_vars, collapse = " + ")))
fit_multi     <- glm(formula_multi, data = df_multi, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
sum_multi     <- summary(fit_multi)
ci_multi      <- suppressMessages(confint.default(fit_multi))

if (length(kandidat_vars) >= 2) {
  vif_vals <- car::vif(fit_multi)
  tabel_vif <- tibble(
    Variabel = names(vif_vals),
    VIF      = round(as.numeric(vif_vals), 2),
    Status   = ifelse(as.numeric(vif_vals) >= 5, "Waspada Multikolinearitas", "Aman (<5)")
  )
  max_vif <- max(tabel_vif$VIF, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  tabel_vif <- tibble(Variabel = kandidat_vars, VIF = NA_real_, Status = "Prediktor Tunggal")
  max_vif   <- NA_real_
}

coef_mat <- sum_multi$coefficients
tabel_multivariat <- tibble(
  Term    = rownames(coef_mat),
  Beta    = coef_mat[, "Estimate"],
  SE      = coef_mat[, "Std. Error"],
  aOR     = exp(coef_mat[, "Estimate"]),
  CI_Low  = exp(ci_multi[, 1]),
  CI_High = exp(ci_multi[, 2]),
  p_num   = coef_mat[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
) %>%
  filter(Term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    aOR_CI  = paste0(fmt_num(aOR, 2), " (", fmt_num(CI_Low, 2), "–", fmt_num(CI_High, 2), ")"),
    p_value = fmt_p(p_num)
  )

row_albi_mul <- tabel_multivariat %>% filter(grepl("^ALBI_Kat", Term))
aor_albi     <- fmt_num(row_albi_mul$aOR, 2)
aor_albi_lo  <- fmt_num(row_albi_mul$CI_Low, 2)
aor_albi_hi  <- fmt_num(row_albi_mul$CI_High, 2)
p_albi_mul   <- row_albi_mul$p_value

pred_prob <- predict(fit_multi, type = "response")
roc_model <- roc(df_multi$Respon_Bin, pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
auc_model <- fmt_num(as.numeric(auc(roc_model)), 3)
```

## Pendahuluan

Karsinoma sel hati (KSH) merupakan keganasan hati primer paling dominan (85%–90% kasus) yang sebagian besar terdiagnosis pada stadium menengah hingga lanjut sehingga membutuhkan terapi sistemik lini pertama seperti lenvatinib.[@kudo2018lenvatinib; @pphi2017] Cadangan fungsional hati residual berperan krusial dalam menentukan tolerabilitas dosis dan respon antitumor. Skor Albumin-Bilirubin (ALBI) menawarkan penilaian objektif berbasis albumin serum dan bilirubin total tanpa bias subjektif skor Child-Turcotte-Pugh (CTP).[@johnson2015assessment] Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan skor ALBI pra-terapi dengan respon radiologis mRECIST dalam rentang 12–16 minggu pertama terapi lenvatinib pada pasien KSH tidak dapat direseksi di RSUP Prof. dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah Denpasar.

## Metode

Penelitian ini merupakan studi analitik kohort retrospektif berbasis rekam medis pada pasien KSH tidak dapat direseksi (BCLC B non-kandidat terapi kuratif/lokoregional dan BCLC C) usia $\ge 18$ tahun yang memulai terapi lenvatinib di RSUP Prof. dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah Denpasar periode 1 Januari 2023 hingga 31 Desember 2025 dengan target besar sampel minimal 68 pasien. Kriteria eksklusi mencakup riwayat transplantasi hati, kehamilan selama perawatan, serta penghentian terapi $< 12$ minggu di luar kejadian kematian. Evaluasi luaran mengikuti prinsip intention-to-treat (ITT), yakni pasien yang meninggal sebelum menjalani CT evaluasi minggu ke-12–16 diklasifikasikan sebagai penyakit progresif. Dosis standar penyebut Relative Dose Intensity (RDI) 12 minggu ditetapkan berdasarkan berat badan ($\ge 60\text{ kg}: 12\text{ mg/hari}$; $< 60\text{ kg}: 8\text{ mg/hari}$). Seluruh pengolahan data dilakukan menggunakan RStudio dan Quarto dengan uji normalitas Shapiro–Wilk, kurva ROC/AUC untuk penentuan cut-off variabel numerik, uji Chi-square/Fisher exact beserta Relative Risk (RR), serta regresi logistik biner multivariat beserta uji Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) untuk mendeteksi multikolinearitas antar skor fungsi hati/nutrisi (ALBI, CTP, dan PNI).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-karakteristik

#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

ringkas_num <- function(x, label) {
  x_clean <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x_clean) == 0) {
    return(tibble(Karakteristik = label, `n Valid` = 0L, `Nilai / n (%)` = "-"))
  }
  p_norm <- if (length(x_clean) >= 3 && length(x_clean) <= 5000 && length(unique(x_clean)) > 1) {
    shapiro.test(x_clean)$p.value
  } else {
    0
  }
  if (p_norm >= 0.05) {
    val <- paste0(fmt_num(mean(x_clean), 2), " ± ", fmt_num(sd(x_clean), 2), " (Rerata ± SD)")
  } else {
    q <- quantile(x_clean, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75))
    val <- paste0(fmt_num(q[2], 2), " (", fmt_num(q[1], 2), "–", fmt_num(q[3], 2), ") (Median [IQR])")
  }
  tibble(Karakteristik = label, `n Valid` = length(x_clean), `Nilai / n (%)` = val)
}

ringkas_kat <- function(x, label) {
  tab <- table(x, useNA = "no")
  tot <- sum(tab)
  if (tot == 0) return(tibble(Karakteristik = paste0("**", label, "**"), `n Valid` = 0L, `Nilai / n (%)` = "-"))
  pct <- 100 * tab / tot
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Karakteristik = paste0("**", label, "**"), `n Valid` = as.integer(tot), `Nilai / n (%)` = ""),
    tibble(
      Karakteristik   = paste0("— ", names(tab)),
      `n Valid`       = NA_integer_,
      `Nilai / n (%)` = paste0(as.integer(tab), " (", fmt_num(pct, 1), "%)")
    )
  )
}
```

### Penentuan Titik Potong Variabel Numerik (Kurva ROC/AUC)

Kurva ROC variabel usia menghasilkan AUC sebesar r auc_usia (95% CI: `r auc_usia_lo`–`r auc_usia_hi`) dengan titik potong optimal `r cutoff_usia` tahun (sensitivitas `r sens_usia`%, spesifisitas `r spec_usia`%). Skor ALBI kontinu menunjukkan AUC sebesar `r auc_albi` (95% CI: `r auc_albi_lo`–`r auc_albi_hi`) dengan titik potong empiris `r cut_albi_op` (@fig-roc).

```{r}
#| label: fig-roc
#| fig-cap: "Kurva ROC penentuan titik potong usia (kiri) dan evaluasi diskriminasi skor ALBI kontinu (kanan) dalam memprediksi penyakit terkontrol."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(roc_usia, col = "#1f78b4", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE,
     main = paste0("ROC Usia (AUC = ", auc_usia, ")"))
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray50")
legend("bottomright", legend = paste0("Cut-off: ", cutoff_usia, " th"), bty = "n")

plot(roc_albi, col = "#d95f02", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE,
     main = paste0("ROC Skor ALBI Kontinu (AUC = ", auc_albi, ")"))
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray50")
legend("bottomright", legend = paste0("Cut-off empiris: ", cut_albi_op), bty = "n")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Analisis Multivariat (Regresi Logistik Biner) dan Uji Multikolinearitas

Setelah penyesuaian terhadap variabel perancu, ALBI Derajat 1 menunjukkan adjusted Odds Ratio (aOR) sebesar `r aor_albi` (95% CI: `r aor_albi_lo`–`r aor_albi_hi`; $p =$ `r p_albi_mul`) dengan diskriminasi model AUC = `r auc_model` dan nilai VIF maksimum = `r max_vif` (@tbl-multivariat; @tbl-vif; @fig-forest-aor). `r if (length(vars_dilewati_missing) > 0) paste0("Catatan: variabel berikut dikecualikan dari model multivariat utama karena proporsi data kosong melebihi ", MAX_MISSING_MULTI * 100, "%: ", paste(vars_dilewati_missing, collapse = ", "), ".")`

```{r}
p_forest_aor <- ggplot(tabel_multivariat, aes(x = aOR, y = reorder(Term, aOR))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Low, xmax = CI_High), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, color = "#1f78b4") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (Skala Log, 95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_forest_aor
```
